note: Measured gate-lane wall clock on successful CI. Read by tools/gate-duration.mjs; CI fails when a lane exceeds the committed baseline by more than maxFactor. Re-measure before changing a baseline; do not hand-edit a number just to make CI green.

Recent three-run mean = 25.3m; deliberately rounded to 25.5m (1530s), preserving maxFactor=1.25 (31.875m guard). Growth includes a larger authored event pool (452 to 462 in this window), but run-to-run variability and engine/runner costs also contribute; the 10 extra events alone do not explain the full increase. This updates only the measured wall-clock reference, not samples, simulation assertions or thresholds. Old 21m baseline originated at PR #364 run 36586278258 (20.7m). Sources: https://github.com/EldritchDynasty/EldritchDynasty/actions/runs/38130485155 ; https://github.com/EldritchDynasty/EldritchDynasty/actions/runs/38238992858 ; https://github.com/EldritchDynasty/EldritchDynasty/actions/runs/38384695888. Previous evidence: Isolated fire-rate lane on PR #364 run 36586278258: 20.7 min (1240s) with fire-rate, outcome-reach and vocabulary-reach all passing. Baseline rounded to 21m; 1.25x guard = 26.25m, so runner noise is not treated as a regression (#333). Attribution follow-up (#1641, #1679; docs/BALANCE-LOG.md, 2026-10-14 and 2026-10-15): fixed-runner Node v24.19.0, official seed prefix 5000+7*i, 20 runs x 500 requested years. A separate repeated spouse-history scan introduced by 79f0e6e1 (#786) was removed by merged PR #1642 / child #1646 (f5df1e56): the combined msg()/rival optimization on current 7412a5ae content improves identical profiled 100x500 batches from 202.323s to 172.677s wall (-14.7%) and 216.055s to 185.393s CPU (-14.2%); aggregate gate hash and all eight 400-year saved-world digests match. Parent #1641 stays open for that gap and the next three scheduled nightly timings. The 1530s baseline and 1.25 factor remain the pre-optimization reference until new hosted evidence justifies recalibration. Historical hosted jobs 113780637094 (Oct 9 run 37918549600) and 114443600843 (Oct 11 run 38130485155) log the same Actions runner 2.337.0, ubuntu-24.04 image 20261004.327.1, Node v22.23.3 and npm 10.9.9; no logged image/Node-version change explains their timing difference, while physical CPU performance and contention remain unmeasured.
